message: "doz" must be "space/3" (the format this reader knows), got the text "space/2"
yaml:
doz: space/2
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada

doz: space/3
space: t
owner: ada

message: "My Space" is not a space name
hint: a space name is a lower-case letter, then lower-case letters, digits and -
yaml:
doz: space/3
space: My Space
brief: B.md
owner: ada

spec: a key is unknown (with a suggestion), unless it starts with x-
message: unknown key "servics" in the file (did you mean "services"?)
yaml:
doz: space/3
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada
servics: {}

spec: a key is unknown (with a suggestion), unless it starts with x-
message: unknown key "modle" in agent "w" (did you mean "model"?)
yaml:
doz: space/3
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada
agents:
  w: { kind: claude-code, isolation: fenced, modle: x }

hint: names are a lower-case letter, then lower-case letters, digits and -
yaml:
doz: space/3
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada
agents:
  Worker: { kind: claude-code, isolation: fenced }

message: "x" is used twice: as folder and as agent
hint: names share one namespace across sections, so a persist entry or a member list can point at any of them
yaml:
doz: space/3
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada
folders:
  x: {}
agents:
  x: { kind: claude-code, isolation: fenced }

hint: set MISSING in the .env file beside the space file, or in the environment; or give a default: ${MISSING:-value}
yaml:
doz: space/3
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada
title: "${MISSING}"

spec: a definition has external: and owned keys
hint: an entry either references something that exists (external:) or describes something the space owns, never both: remove "kind", or remove external: to have the space make "admin"
yaml:
doz: space/3
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada
agents:
  admin:
    external: { bot: manager }
    kind: claude-code

spec: a definition has external: and owned keys
hint: an entry either references something that exists (external:) or describes something the space owns, never both: remove "cpus", or remove external: to have the space make "vm"
yaml:
doz: space/3
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada
sandboxes:
  vm: { external: true, cpus: 2 }

space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada

  rooms:
    general: { external: "doz://host-a/general" }

spec: an agent is referenced by { folder: … }
message: an external agent can't be identified by its folder
hint: two sessions can share a folder, and a folder says nothing about who answers: write { bot: NAME }, { session: NAME } or doz://HOST/_/bot/NAME
yaml:
doz: space/3
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada
agents:
  admin: { external: { folder: ~/x } }

hint: write external: { bot: manager }

space: t
brief: B.md

owner: ada

doz: space/3
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada

spec: a ${VAR} appears in a secret
hint: resolved values appear in the plan; a secret is an external reference: { keychain: ITEM } or { file: PATH }

space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada
secrets:
  k: { external: { file: "${TOKEN_FILE}" }, to: api.github.com }

spec: permissions: bypass (written) on a Mac agent that does not write its own isolation
message: agent "w" runs with permissions: bypass, so it must write its own isolation
hint: isolation: unfenced gives it full access to your user (as you); isolation: fenced runs it behind Dozable's fence. It is always written on the agent itself, never inherited
yaml:
doz: space/3
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada
agents:
  w: { kind: claude-code, permissions: bypass }

spec: permissions: bypass (inherited) on a Mac agent that does not write its own isolation
message: agent "w" runs with permissions: bypass (from defaults.yaml:2), so it must write its own isolation
hint: isolation: unfenced gives it full access to your user (as you); isolation: fenced runs it behind Dozable's fence. It is always written on the agent itself, never inherited
yaml:
doz: space/3
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada
agents:
  w: { kind: claude-code }

spec: permissions: bypass (the space's) on a Mac agent that does not write its own isolation
message: agent "w" runs with permissions: bypass (the space's permissions, space.yaml:5), so it must write its own isolation
hint: isolation: unfenced gives it full access to your user (as you); isolation: fenced runs it behind Dozable's fence. It is always written on the agent itself, never inherited
yaml:
doz: space/3
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada
permissions: bypass
agents:
  w: { kind: claude-code }

spec: a null that removes isolation is caught (checked after merging)
message: agent "w" runs with permissions: bypass, so it must write its own isolation (in the override file)
hint: isolation: unfenced gives it full access to your user (as you); isolation: fenced runs it behind Dozable's fence. It is always written on the agent itself, never inherited
yaml:
doz: space/3
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada
agents:
  w: { kind: claude-code, permissions: bypass, isolation: fenced }

spec: a defaults file sets isolation: unfenced in agent_defaults
hint: an agent is never unfenced by inheritance: write isolation: unfenced on each agent that needs it. agent_defaults may set isolation: fenced
yaml:
doz: space/3
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada

hint: an agent is never unfenced by inheritance: write isolation: unfenced on each agent that needs it. agent_defaults may set isolation: fenced
yaml:

space: t

owner: ada

message: an agent in a sandbox is never unfenced: the VM is the boundary
hint: remove isolation:
yaml:
doz: space/3
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada
sandboxes:
  vm: { image: claude-code }
agents:
  b: { kind: claude-code, where: "sandbox:vm", isolation: unfenced }

spec: an agent whose memory is persisted says transcripts: discard
message: "w" has its memory persisted, so its transcripts can't be discarded
hint: persisting keeps its conversations (the next run starts it with --continue); discarding would delete them. Remove transcripts: discard, or stop persisting its memory
yaml:
doz: space/3
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada
agents:
  w: { kind: claude-code, isolation: fenced, transcripts: discard }
persist:
  mem: { agent: w }

spec: an agent whose memory is persisted says transcripts: discard
message: "w" has its memory persisted, so its transcripts can't be discarded
hint: persisting keeps its conversations (the next run starts it with --continue); discarding would delete them. Remove transcripts: discard, or stop persisting its memory

spec: an owned folder has a path:
hint: an owned folder has no path: it is a scratch folder made inside the run folder. For a folder that exists, write external: PATH; for data that outlives runs, persist: { NAME: { folder: PATH } }
yaml:
doz: space/3
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada
folders:
  scratch: { path: scratch }

spec: a resource has a lifetime: key
hint: persistence is declared under the top-level persist:, e.g. persist: { team-chat: { room: NAME } }; anything not listed lasts one run
yaml:
doz: space/3
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada
chat:
  rooms:
    team: { lifetime: space }

hint: transcripts is set per agent now: on each agent, or for all of them in agent_defaults: { transcripts: discard }
yaml:
doz: space/3
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada
transcripts: discard

  w: { kind: claude-code, isolation: fenced, start: false }

  rooms:
    team: {}

spec: archive.to is inside a folder any agent of the space can write
message: the archive would be inside repo (~/work/repo), which agent "w" can write
hint: the archive is evidence: put it where no agent of the space can write, such as the default in the doz store
yaml:
doz: space/3
space: t
brief: B.md
owner: ada
folders:
  repo: { external: ~/work/repo }
agents:
  w: { kind: claude-code, isolation: fenced, folder: repo }
archive:
  to: "~/work/repo/archive/{space}/runs/{run}"
